name: whop
description: Connect Whop to Fractal through its MCP server and access the operations exposed to the connected account.

interface.shortDescription: Use Whop MCP tools from your Fractal workspace.
interface.longDescription: Connect Whop to your Fractal workspace so your agent can work with digital products and memberships using the tools exposed by the service. Available actions depend on the live MCP server and the connected account’s permissions.
defaultPrompt: Give me an overview of my Whop workspace.
Find anything in Whop that needs attention and explain why.
Help me review digital products and memberships in Whop.
